name: The 14 Nations
description: North America in an age when no fleet came to stay — 62 territories across 14 nations, from the Salmon League on the Pacific coast to the Triple Alliance and the League of Mayapán. Every border follows the land: the Missouri and the Mississippi, the Rio Grande, the Continental Divide, the Sierras Madre and the Appalachian crest. Hold a nation's homeland, or break it at the river.
